─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
RED BASELINE
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Initial run after writing the 9 P0 tests:
  PASSED: 7
  FAILED: 1 (Phase5FormsTest.ResetFormRestoresDefaultValues)
  SKIPPED: 1 (Phase5FormsTest.PushButtonToggleNoCrash — fixture lacks
              pushbutton)

Failure details for ResetFormRestoresDefaultValues:
  test_forms_phase5.cpp(309): error: Expected equality of these values:
    fieldsAfter[i].value
      Which is: "DIRTY_VALUE_2"
    dvValues[dvIdx]
      Which is: ""
    Field 2 not restored to /DV after reset.

Root cause: my test loop captured baseline values from ALL text fields
on test_form_with_dv.pdf, including fields without /DV (initial value
empty string). Per documented MuPDF behavior (and the audit row
UI-FORM-15 itself), "fields without /DV are unchanged" by resetForm.
The empty-initial fields stay dirty, which is correct production
behavior. Test expectation was wrong.

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIX
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Test logic narrowed to only assert the contract on fields whose
initial value was non-empty (i.e., they actually have /DV). If
test_form_with_dv.pdf turns out to have NO /DV-bearing fields,
the test SKIPs with rationale rather than producing a false PASS
or FAIL. Production code is unchanged; the test now correctly
reflects the documented MuPDF /DV semantics.
